item.title: Dodgers Smash Spending Record: MLB data shows $514.6m outlay in 2025; gap with low-payroll teams widens
item.description: The Los Angeles Dodgers shattered MLB spending records in 2025 with a $514.6 million total payroll and luxury tax bill, powering their second straight World Series title. Their outlay dwarfed rivals, including a budget more than seven times the Miami Marlins’ and exceeding the bottom six teams combined. The spending gap highlights growing financial disparity across Major League Baseball.

Meet Yasuyuki Aono: Japanese scientist who kept a 1,200-year cherry blossom record alive until his death
item.description: Professor Yasuyuki Aono meticulously tracked Kyoto's cherry blossom bloom dates for over a millennium, revealing a significant shift towards earlier flowering. His lifelong dedication, documented in ancient scripts, created a unique historical record. Following his passing, a new researcher has stepped forward to continue this vital, centuries-long observation of climate change.

item.title: What unfolded during the Iga Swiatek Alex Eala session? Viewers surprised when hot mic picked up Carol Vorderman discussion
item.description: A live tennis stream from Stuttgart took an unexpected turn when a camera crew’s private talk about Carol Vorderman was heard on air. The men, unaware their mic was live, made comments that quickly went viral. Reports say they are not linked to the WTA and felt embarrassed. Vorderman’s past statements on relationships also resurfaced after the incident.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Pokimane and Valkyrae face backlash after distancing from Sykkuno as Fuslie NoahJ456 past controversy fuels hypocrisy claims
item.description: Pokimane and Valkyrae are facing backlash after distancing from Sykkuno during serious allegations. Fans are comparing this to their continued friendship with Fuslie, whose past controversy with NoahJ456 has resurfaced. While some call it hypocrisy, others say the situations are different. With Sykkuno still silent, the debate around fairness and accountability continues to divide the streaming community.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Accused man in Vitaly stream shares police audio, father plans legal action
item.description: A man falsely accused by a viral livestreamer has released police audio suggesting he was in the wrong place at the wrong time. The recording indicates no criminal offense was involved, contradicting the livestream's claims of racism and bullying. The accused's family, aided by a lawyer, plans legal action over the reputational damage.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Roy

item.title: Kick streamer Clavicular dodges Charleston White question on overdose stunt at club launch days after hospital incident
item.description: Clavicular, also known as Braden Peters, refused to discuss his suspected overdose when asked by Charleston White at a club event. The question came days after a livestream incident where he was hospitalized. He later confirmed being discharged but did not explain the situation clearly, leaving many questions unanswered about what really happened.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Roy

item.title: Veteran journalist claims WNBA pressured reporters to ignore Fudd–Bueckers relationship in draft coverage
item.description: The Dallas Wings’ selection of Azzi Fudd at No. 1 overall to reunite her with Paige Bueckers drew attention beyond basketball, given their history as UConn teammates and reported relationship. Journalist Jeff Pearlman questioned why coverage largely avoided mentioning it, suggesting broader sensitivities around LGBT narratives in sports media. The debate now sits alongside expectations for the Wings’ new backcourt.
item.dc:creator: TOI Sports Desk

item.title: Pension Schemes Bill: MPs back powers to steer private pensions; House of Lords to review next week
item.description: In a bold shift, Parliament has empowered the Labour Party to steer private pension investments, a key development in the Pension Schemes Bill. This regulation introduces a framework for government-led initiatives to funnel retirement savings into critical areas such as domestic infrastructure.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Candace Owens reignites Charlie Kirk cremation question as Erika Kirk and Turning Point USA face fresh claims
item.description: Candace Owens has again raised questions about Charlie Kirk’s death and Erika Kirk’s leadership. She asked if Kirk was cremated, mocked Erika Kirk’s absence from a JD Vance event, and accused Turning Point USA of using edited footage. Owens also repeated her “Charlie GPT” theory and donor claims, but no evidence has been verified so far.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Scientists create a ‘light switch’ for the love hormone: How it could change how humans love and form bonds
item.description: Scientists have unveiled a revolutionary 'light switch' technique, enabling precise activation of the brain's love hormone, oxytocin. This breakthrough allows researchers to observe how individual neurons and brain circuits form emotions, bonding, and social behaviours in real-time. The method promises deeper understanding of the human brain and potential targeted treatments for mental health conditions.

item.title: Passengers step off overweight flight: EasyJet trims load; warm weather and short runway blamed
item.description: On Saturday morning, an EasyJet flight to Malaga took an unexpected detour as it faced a notable delay due to the aircraft's weight exceeding safety limits for the conditions. In a show of cooperation, five passengers chose to disembark, enabling the flight to recalibrate and continue its journey.
